p.i: Jesus Christ sheweth himself unto the people of Nephi, as the multitude were gathered together in the land Bountiful, and did minister unto them; and on this wise did he shew himself unto them.

chapter.li: LEChapter11 Verse1 And now it came to pass that there were a great multitude gathered together of the people of Nephi, round about the temple which was in the land Bountiful; and they were marveling and wondering one with another, and were shewing one to another the great and marvelous change which had taken place. VerseEnd Verse2 And they were also conversing about this Jesus Christ, of whom the sign had been given concerning his death. VerseEnd

Verse3 And it came to pass that while they were thus conversing one with another, they heard a voice as if it came out of Heaven. And they cast their eyes round about, for they understood not the voice which they heard; and it was not a harsh voice, neither was it a loud voice. Nevertheless, and notwithstanding it being a small voice, it did pierce them that did hear to the center, insomuch that there were no part of their frame that it did not cause to quake, yea, it did pierce them to the very soul and did cause their hearts to burn. VerseEnd Verse4 And it came to pass that again they heard the voice and they understood it not. VerseEnd Verse5 And again the third time they did hear the voice and did open their ears to hear it, and their eyes were towards the sound thereof, and they did look steadfastly towards Heaven, from whence the sound came. VerseEnd Verse6 And behold, the third time they did understand the voice which they heard, and it said unto them, VerseEnd Verse7 Behold my Beloved Son in whom I am well pleased, in whom I have glorified my name; hear 2PP ye him. VerseEnd

Verse8 And it came to pass, as they understood, they cast their eyes up again towards Heaven.
